# konnect_identity_vault_provider_credential (Resource)

IdentityVaultProviderCredential Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_identity_vault_provider_credential" "my_identityvaultprovidercredential" {
  directory_id = "a0910333-5df8-4d68-aef7-6e231472328b"
  priority     = 1
  provider_id  = "4dc79705-5348-49ee-8649-386f87194874"
  secret       = "...my_secret..."
  selector     = "...my_selector..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_id` (String) ID of the directory
- `provider_id` (String) ID of the vault provider

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) Order in which this credential is considered, lowest first. Required with a selector, and must be omitted without one.
- `secret` (String) Pre-issued static credential (API key, PAT, etc.). Stored encrypted, never returned in read APIs.
- `selector` (String) CEL expression deciding which callers this credential applies to. Omit to make it the provider's default, which applies to every caller and is considered after all the others.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `shared_obj` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shared_obj))
- `status` (String) "pending" until admin enrollment completes; "active" once the secret exists.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `user` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `enrollment_url` (String) URL to complete OAuth consent. Fresh on every get-by-id call; set on create for a shared authorization_code provider. Omitted from list responses.
- `id` (String)
- `priority` (Number)
- `selector` (String)
- `status` (String) "pending" until admin enrollment completes; "active" once the secret exists.
- `updated_at` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry of the current access token, if any.
- `id` (String)
- `principal` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user--principal))
- `status` (String) A user credential exists only once authorization has completed, so this is always "active".

- `id` (String) The principal's ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_identity_vault_provider_credential.my_konnect_identity_vault_provider_credential
  id = jsonencode({
    directory_id = "..."
    id           = "..."
    provider_id  = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_identity_vault_provider_credential.my_konnect_identity_vault_provider_credential '{"directory_id": "...", "id": "...", "provider_id": "..."}'
```
